def read_task_file(self) -> Tuple[Optional[str], float]:
    """读取任务文件 - 下载JPG到本地，20秒超时，失败返回None"""
    config = self.file_config
    cmd = f'scp -o ConnectTimeout=5 {config["user"]}@{config["host"]}:"{config["file_path"]}" {self.local_path}'
    
    result = subprocess.run(
        cmd, 
        shell=True, 
        capture_output=True, 
        text=True, 
        timeout=20
    )
    
    if result.returncode == 0 and os.path.exists(self.local_path):
        return self.local_path, read_time
    return None, read_time
```

            {
                "role": "user",
                "content": [
                    {
                        "type": "text",
                        "text": "Summarize the content of the figure",

                    {

                    },

            }

        stream=stream,
    )

def read_task_file(self) -> Tuple[Optional[str], float]:
    """读取任务文件 - 20秒超时，失败返回None"""
    config = self.file_config
    cmd = f'ssh -o ConnectTimeout=5 {config["user"]}@{config["host"]} "cat \"{config["file_path"]}\""'
    
    result = subprocess.run(
        cmd, 
        shell=True, 
        capture_output=True, 
        text=True, 
        timeout=20
    )

        content = result.stdout.strip()
        return content, read_time
    return None, read_time
```

import openai
import time
time1 = time.time()
from openai import OpenAI
import random
import time

client = OpenAI(
    api_key="sk-123",
    base_url="http://demo-server.local:31783/v1",
)

def llm_solve_problem(input_context):
    random.seed(10)
    start_time = time.time()
    if len(input_context)>= 2300:
        response = '您的问题太长，作为一个AI模型，可接受的问题长度有限，暂时无法回答这么长的问题'
        time_consume = time.time() - start_time
        return response, time_consume
    else:
        chat_completion = client.chat.completions.create(
            messages=[
                {
                    "role": "user",
                    "content": input_context,
                }
            ],
            model="qwen15-7b",
        )
        response = chat_completion.choices[0].message.content
        time_consume = time.time() - start_time
    print(response)
    return response, time_consume

if __name__ == '__main__':
    llm_solve_problem('Please introduce OpenAI in 500 words')
```

def read_task_file(self) -> Tuple[Optional[str], float]:
    """读取任务文件 - 下载JPG到本地，20秒超时，失败返回None"""
    config = self.file_config
    cmd = f'scp -o ConnectTimeout=5 {config["user"]}@{config["host"]}:"{config["file_path"]}" {self.local_path}'
    
    result = subprocess.run(
        cmd, 
        shell=True, 
        capture_output=True, 
        text=True, 
        timeout=20

        return self.local_path, read_time
